experience.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Model Evaluation & Training
bullets: Evaluated model-written code and technical answers for correctness, instruction following, efficiency and security, reproducing each claimed fix in a clean environment and writing an evidence-based rationale for every rating.
Ranked paired model responses to coding and debugging prompts against project guidelines and wrote the justification behind each preference, producing human preference data for model training.

Reviewed multi-step coding-agent trajectories (diffs, tool calls, terminal output, test runs and logs) and documented the step where a solution passed the visible tests but missed the stated requirement, a boundary input or an error path.

Authored more than 300 coding-benchmark tasks in Python and TypeScript, each with a problem statement, a reference solution and a hidden pytest or Jest suite covering edge cases and error handling, verified to reject known-incorrect solutions.

Built Python evaluation harnesses that ran model-generated code against hidden tests inside isolated Docker containers with time and memory limits, recording pass, fail, timeout and runtime-error outcomes per task.

Wrote technical rubrics defining correct, partially correct and failing answers for code, debugging and data-analysis tasks, then calibrated reviewers on shared sample sets, cutting rubric-related rework by 22 percent.

Audited completed evaluations from the reviewer pool against the rubric, classified recurring model failures (logic errors, unhandled edge cases, invented APIs, tests that do not prove the fix) and fed the patterns back into task guidelines.
Built finance-domain evaluation tasks on portfolio returns, risk metrics and financial-statement analysis, checking every model answer against an independently computed result in pandas.

experience.title: Software Developer (Part-time)
bullets: Built web applications, REST APIs and reporting dashboards for small-business clients with Python (Flask), JavaScript, React and PostgreSQL, owning scoping, implementation, testing and deployment.

Automated recurring business workflows with Python scripts and scheduled jobs that pulled data from third-party APIs into reporting databases, replacing manual spreadsheet updates across 12 client engagements.
Debugged and extended inherited client codebases, adding input validation, error handling and tests before shipping changes to production.

experience.title: Financial Analyst
bullets: Analyzed portfolio performance and return attribution for managed client accounts, preparing monthly reporting packages for portfolio managers and investment committees.
Built financial models in Excel and Python covering volatility, drawdown, value at risk and factor exposure, and ran stress scenarios on rate and market shocks.
Automated recurring portfolio and risk reports with Python and SQL against holdings databases, reducing preparation from about two days to four hours per cycle.
Reconciled positions and performance figures across more than 2,000 accounts, tracing discrepancies to source data and documenting the fixes.
